title: Direct Forcing: Single-Stage Training with Representation-Space Supervision for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
title_zh: Direct Forcing：面向少步自回归视频生成的单阶段表征空间监督训练

paragraphs.en: 提出单阶段训练框架Direct Forcing，结合因果对齐与分布匹配，仅需250次更新即可训练出四步自回归视频生成器。 Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting with an ODE initialization stage, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce \method, the first single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Specifically, Direct Forcing is trained with two complementary signals: (1) Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories; and (2) Rollout Distribution Matching employs maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. To coordinate these signals, we introduce Dynamic Gradient Balancing, which adapts their relative gradient contributions during training. Experiments with Wan2.1-1.3B show that Direct Forcing learns a four-step autoregressive generator in 250 updates without a separate ODE initialization stage or online diffusion-score supervision, achieving 84.63 VBench Total and 86.01 Quality.
paragraphs.zh: 提出单阶段训练框架Direct Forcing，结合因果对齐与分布匹配，仅需250次更新即可训练出四步自回归视频生成器。少步自回归视频生成能够实现低延迟流式传输，然而主流的训练流程将因果适配与分布匹配相互分离。 近期基于表示的文生视频方法即使目标分布直接由参考视频定义，也仍然沿用了这种分离方式，即从ODE初始化阶段开始训练。 我们提出\method，这是首个单阶段框架，将参考视频同时用作展示历史如何延续的配对样本，以及用于自生成rollout的目标总体。 具体而言，Direct Forcing由两个互补信号进行训练：（1）因果延续对齐在参考历史下学习配对的时空对应关系；（2）rollout分布匹配采用最大均值差异来对齐自生成视频与参考视频的表示分布。 为协调这两个信号，我们引入动态梯度平衡，在训练过程中自适应地调整二者的相对梯度贡献。 在Wan2.1-1.3B上的实验表明，Direct Forcing无需单独的ODE初始化阶段或在线扩散-分数监督，仅用250次更新便训练出一个四步自回归生成器，在VBench上取得84.63总分和86.01质量分。
